column2: # 中文：这是教材用于说明“不合适的图形”的对照：room_type 只有类别，没有用于计算四分位数的数值分布。
# English: This is the workbook's unsuitable-plot comparison: room_type contains categories, without a numeric distribution for meaningful quartiles.
# 中文：仅把分类变量映射到单轴再调用 geom_boxplot() 不构成有解释意义的分组箱线图；可能出现无意义图形或警告。
# English: Mapping only a category to one axis does not make an interpretable grouped boxplot and may yield meaningless output or warnings.
# 中文：想展示类别频数应看下一块 geom_bar()；想做分组箱线图则需要同时映射一个数值变量。
# English: Use the next geom_bar() chunk for category frequencies; a grouped boxplot needs a numeric variable as well as a category.
